# url-credentials: a credential embedded in the authority part of a URL.
# format: <rule id> TAB <line>.
password-in-url	https://widget-ci:{S32}@artifacts.example.internal/repository/releases/
database-connection-string-postgres	postgres://widget:{S32}@db.example.internal:5432/widget
database-connection-string-mongodb	mongodb+srv://widget:{S32}@cluster0.example.internal/widget
password-in-url	amqps://widget:{S32}@broker.example.internal:5671/widget
